svg.title: amd-hackathon-2026
svg.desc: LLM fine-tune. 48h solo, one MI300X. Fine-tuned Qwen3.6-35B-A3B end to end on one AMD GPU: LoRA, merge and abliteration, shipped as a 9-quant GGUF ladder on Hugging Face. Safety runs at the app layer with Llama Guard 3. Built with PyTorch, LoRA, ROCm, vLLM, W&B.

g.text: Fine-tuned Qwen3.6-35B-A3B end to end on one AMD GPU: LoRA,
merge and abliteration, shipped as a 9-quant GGUF ladder on
Hugging Face. Safety runs at the app layer with Llama Guard 3.
